description: This Java source file defines a utility class ProvisioningHelper used in integration tests for provisioning criteria and journal entries related to the Apache Fineract project. It contains methods for creating JSON strings and data structures for provisioning configurations, with some deprecated methods for building provisioning criteria and entries.

classes.name: ProvisioningHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating provisioning criteria and journal entries in JSON format used in integration tests for Apache Fineract.

methods.name: createProvisioingCriteriaJson
methods.description: Creates a JSON map for provisioning criteria with specified loan products, categories, and accounts, including a formatted date in the criteria name.

methods.name: createProvisioningEntryJson
methods.description: Generates JSON string to create a provisioning journal entry with journal entries disabled.

methods.name: createProvisioningEntryJsonWithJournalsEnabled
methods.description: Generates JSON string to create a provisioning journal entry with journal entries enabled.

methods.name: addLoanProducts
methods.description: Helper method that converts a list of loan product IDs into a list of maps with 'id' keys.

methods.name: addProvisioningCategories
methods.description: Creates a list of provisioning categories with associated account IDs, age ranges, and provisioning percentages.
